payload.seo_title: Destination Wedding Cost per Guest and Who Pays for What
payload.meta_description: See what a destination wedding costs per guest, from per-head catering and minimum spends to guest rooms and transfers, and what couples usually host.
secondary_keywords: how much does a destination wedding cost per guest
who pays for guests at a destination wedding

audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+, 70 to 110 guests, mostly Italy and Europe, some Bali, Fiji, Maldives, Dubai. Parent paying wants to know where each dollar per guest goes.

payload.search_intent: Informational with budgeting intent: 'what will each guest cost us abroad, and what do guests pay themselves?'
payload.angle: Cost per guest is not one number. Split the wedding into lines that scale with each guest (catering, drinks, transfers, levies, minimum-spend shortfalls) and lines that do not (venue hire, planner, photography, legal), quote per-head prices exactly as our live destination cost pages state them, show what guests usually pay for themselves, and show what a Wedded Advisor handles on each line.
serp_gaps_to_win: No ranking page in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane or London gives per-guest costs for a wedding abroad; results are domestic venue pages or 2013 to 2014 US content.
Nobody separates per-head lines from fixed lines for a destination wedding.
Nobody covers per-person levies and transfers (Maldives green tax, Bali levy, seaplanes) as per-guest costs.
Nobody answers 'who pays for guests' by hosting level alongside the cost (PAA and forum boxes show the demand).
Nobody explains why small guest lists cost more per head (minimum spends, guest minimums).

outline.h2: What cost per guest means at a destination wedding
outline.answers: Why one average misleads; per-head lines vs fixed lines; total divided by guests vs the cost of one more guest.
must_include: Do not quote or link /expert-advice/wedding-cost-per-guest or its A$38,252 figure
No averages computed from totals

outline.h2: What each guest costs for food and drink, by destination
outline.answers: Per-head catering and drinks prices as our live pages state them.
must_include: Table: destination | per-head line quoted verbatim | currency | page | guest count of that page. No conversions, no cross-currency ranking.

Candidates (verbatim from live pages, 26 Nov 2026; researcher to re-check and date): Santorini 'catering is priced at €75 to €160 or more a head' (/real-weddings/santorini-wedding-cost-breakdown); Amalfi 'plated dining and beverages can be estimated at €180 to €310 or more per person' (/real-weddings/amalfi-coast-wedding-cost); Italy 'destination-standard catering usually costs €150 to €220 per guest' (/expert-advice/how-much-does-a-wedding-in-italy-cost); Mykonos 'imported or luxury resort catering pushes past €250 to €300 a head' (/real-weddings/mykonos-wedding-cost); Fiji 'each extra guest adds about FJD $130 to $180 or more' (/real-weddings/fiji-wedding-cost); Dubai 'from AED 200 to AED 595 per person' (/destination-weddings/dubai-wedding-cost); Santorini drinks 'AION lists ... open bar concepts at €25 to €45 per person per hour' (/destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-cost)
Nic signs off every figure
